notes.title: Multiplayer Update 1.2.5 | Warehouse
notes.content:
Soldiers,

Update 1.2.5 is now available!
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33668134/b0b098648d76dcb28ef9e09ccae65711cd4a5d32.jpg

This Update introduces the new map Warehouse to Strike Force Remastered Multiplayer. It's playable in Deathmatch and Teamdeathmacht with full Bot support.

In the near future we will be pushing out several Updates adressing Multiplayer Features and Content.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33668134/ecde31310ee0037816efaebe40956ad8a838a111.jpg

notes.title: Multiplayer Update 1.2.0 | Deathmatch and Ironsights
notes.content:
Soldiers,

Update 1.2.0 is now available!
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33668134/2adbd879bbc32b49ab15d18319ca951be85df903.jpg

With this new update we introduce Ironsights and Deathmatch as Multiplayer mode as well asl AI improvements and more quality improvements.

Changelog:

 added Multiplayer Gamemode Deathmatch
 reworked Multiplayer UI
 improved Multiplayer Bot AI
 improved Dedicated Server Launcher
 added Ironsights so Multiplayer and Singleplayer
 fixed several Multiplayer Map issues
 fixed several Singleplayer Map issues
 improved Singleplayer AI



https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33668134/38c9ae91b1e441502f55bba5fe929bb8e4949cb6.jpg

------------------------------------------------------------

Facebook: West Forest Games

notes.title: Upcoming update | Ironsights, Deathmatch and more
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33668134/2adbd879bbc32b49ab15d18319ca951be85df903.jpg

Hello everyone,

for the continued support of Strike Force Remastered, we would like to show you some of the new features coming with the next update.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33668134/24ee7d08c6c30a4f9f9888fb5ba6e05b9dd79e02.jpg

We added Iron Sights to almost all Weapons in Single- and Multiplayer and added support for more weapons in the future. We are also working on the Multiplayer UI and adding the Gamemode Deathmatch to the game.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33668134/38c9ae91b1e441502f55bba5fe929bb8e4949cb6.jpg

Besides that the ground work for additional gamemodes is done and a lot more minor improvements to the game.

Releasedate of the Update will be announced soon!

------------------------------------------------------------

Facebook: West Forest Games

notes.title: Update 1.1.0 released!
notes.content:
Update 1.1.0 - Menu Update

A new Update for Strike Force Remastered is now available and replaces the old Menu sytsem with a new, better looking system.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33668134/cf3b7458249dcfe23e57f60decd0d48dc75367e8.jpg

This is the first of several major updates coming to Strike Force Remastered. The new menu system is part of a bunch of new feature which required an entirly new Menu.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33668134/c5fc889d710c0075f06514a18a0793c0ee4bb2b1.jpg

CHANGELOG:
UI

 added new menu system


More informations about the upcoming Features and Updates are coming soon.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33668134/c7e48189a902935cbde0450da666bb4a81697221.jpg

------------------------------------------------------------

Facebook: West Forest Games

notes.title: Multiplayer Update 1.0.5 released!
notes.content:
Update 1.0.5

The first update for Strike Force Remastered is now available and addresses several issues with the Multiplayer and improves some elements.

CHANGELOG:
UI

 fixed killfeed alignment
 added background to killfeed entry
 fixed serverbrowser text size
 scoreboard will now be shown before map change
 serverbrowser auto refreshes once opened


Maps

 fixed Bot Spawn on Sari Pul
 added Lobby Cameras to all Maps


Player

 Players can now quick respawn by pressing F


Other

 Bots now get removed on properly match end
 Spectator no longer spawn within the ground


------------------------------------------------------------

Facebook: West Forest Games
